newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMPLOW REACHES AGREEMENT ON MERGER.
newsitem.headline: ZIMPLOW REACHES AGREEMENT ON MERGER.

text.p: Zimbabwean agricultural machinery maker Zimplow Ltd said on Friday that it had reached a final agreement on its proposed merger with Amalgamated Metal (Pty) Ltd, following a due diligence exercise by both parties.
It added that this agreement between the two companies was subject to final approval from the Reserve Bank, which has already agreed in principle, and shareholders.
Zimplow said that approval in principle for the merger had already been received from shareholders holding about 59 percent of Zimplow's issued capital.
